column1: # Nmap NSE script results, keyed on the script id (the name before the ':' in a "| script:"
# block). The nmapscripts detector reads a scripted scan (-sC / -sV / -A / --script) and explains
# what each script found and where to take it. Any *-vuln-* script that reports VULNERABLE but is
# NOT in this table still gets flagged generically - this table just adds detail for the common
# kind:  vuln  = report only when the script says VULNERABLE
#        info  = report whenever the script appears (it is disclosing something useful)
# script                 kind  severity  title  meaning  next
